shellCommands.command: find /workspace -type f -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.git/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" | sort
node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null; git diff package.json

ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/templates/ 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "---APP PAGE CONFIG---"; grep -rn "PageProps\|LayoutProps\|RouteContext" /workspace/node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "---types dir---"; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/types/ 2>/dev/null

cat /workspace/node_modules/next/types/global.d.ts; echo "=== index.d.ts head ==="; grep -n "PageProps\|LayoutProps\|RouteContext\|declare global" /workspace/node_modules/next/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/*.d.ts

grep -n "push\|replace\|__next_route_internal\|LinkProps\|RouteImpl\|typedRoutes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigation.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== app-router-context ==="; grep -rn "push(" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/app-router-context.shared-runtime.d.ts | head; echo "=== typedRoutes default ==="; grep -rn "typedRoutes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head

curl -s -o /dev/null -w "jsonplaceholder:%{http_code}\n" --max-time 10 https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_limit=1 ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "fonts.googleapis:%{http_code}\n" --max-time 10 "https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap"
git rm -r --quiet pages components/AppProvider.js && find . -type d -name pages -not -path "./node_modules/*" && git status --short
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -60

find .next -name "*not-found*" -o -name "_not-found*" | head; echo "=== title/meta in prerendered 404 ==="; f=$(find .next -path "*_not-found*" -name "*.html" | head -1); echo "file: $f"; grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" "$f"; grep -o '<meta name="description"[^>]*>' "$f"; grep -o '<meta name="robots"[^>]*>' "$f"

rm /workspace/app/blog/\[id\]/loading.tsx && npx next build > /tmp/build2.log 2>&1; tail -5 /tmp/build2.log; pkill -f "next start" ; sleep 1; (npx next start -p 3124 > /tmp/next2.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3124/blog/1 && break; sleep 1; done; echo "--- /blog/9999 ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3124/blog/9999; curl -s http://localhost:3124/blog/9999 | grep -oc "404 - Page Not Found"; echo "--- /blog/50 on-demand ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3124/blog/50

(npx next start -p 3125 > /tmp/next3.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3125/blog/1 && break; sleep 1; done; echo "--- /blog/9999 ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3125/blog/9999; echo -n "404 UI present: "; curl -s http://localhost:3125/blog/9999 | grep -c "404 - Page Not Found"; echo "--- /blog/50 on-demand ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3125/blog/50; echo -n "post title rendered: "; curl -s http://localhost:3125/blog/50 | grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>"

B=http://localhost:3125/api/posts
echo "GET /api/posts:"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" $B
echo "POST valid:"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -X POST $B -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"T","content":"C"}'
echo "POST missing content:"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -X POST $B -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"T"}'
echo "POST invalid json:"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -X POST $B -H 'content-type: application/json' -d 'not-json'
echo "DELETE /api/posts (undeclared method):"; curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X DELETE $B | grep -iE "^(HTTP|allow)"
echo "GET /api/posts/7:"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" $B/7
echo "PUT /api/posts/7 (partial):"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -X PUT $B/7 -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"New"}'
echo "DELETE /api/posts/7:"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -X DELETE $B/7
echo "PATCH /api/posts/7 (undeclared):"; curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X PATCH $B/7 | grep -iE "^(HTTP|allow)"

echo "OPTIONS /api/posts:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X OPTIONS http://localhost:3125/api/posts | grep -iE "^(HTTP|allow)"; echo "OPTIONS /api/posts/7:"; curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X OPTIONS http://localhost:3125/api/posts/7 | grep -iE "^(HTTP|allow)"
git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== next-env.d.ts ==="; ls -la next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null && cat next-env.d.ts; echo "=== gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore

echo "=== tsc --noEmit ===" && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "tsc OK"
echo "=== leftover Pages Router APIs ==="
grep -rnE "next/router|next/head'|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|isFallback|NextApiRequest|NextApiResponse|\.js$" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" --include="*.jsx" app components lib 2>/dev/null || echo "none found"
echo "=== remaining .js/.jsx source files ==="
find . -name "*.js" -o -name "*.jsx" | grep -vE "node_modules|\.next|__agent_eval__" || echo "none"
echo "=== pages dir ==="
ls pages 2>&1
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf .next; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25; echo "=== tsconfig re-modified by build? ==="; git diff --stat tsconfig.json
pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /workspace/.next; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25
rm -rf .next && npx next build > /tmp/final-build.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; tail -25 /tmp/final-build.log
git diff --stat tsconfig.json; echo "=== final tree ==="; find app components lib styles -type f | sort; echo "=== status ==="; git status --short
